instruction: Candid office photograph, medium shot. In a modern office meeting room, the Black man in the green t-shirt (R1) sits on the left, body angled right, clapping with open hands and smiling. Beside him on the right, the Black woman with braided hair and glasses (R3) in a white turtleneck also claps and smiles, looking in the same direction. They sit at a light-colored desk with a laptop and a blue mug. Bright, natural indoor lighting illuminates the scene, creating a professional and positive atmosphere.
